c07782b78cad557435d9.en: The Earth spins round once every 24 hours.
c07782b78cad557435d9.id: Bumi (Earth) berputar satu kali setiap 24 jam.

d6aedc32669a73f684ae.en: The side facing the Sun has day. The side facing away has night.
d6aedc32669a73f684ae.id: Sisi yang menghadap Matahari (Sun) mengalami siang. Sisi yang membelakangi Matahari mengalami malam.

ccc90ecd0b23cb6e4f9e.en: The Sun seems to move across the sky. Really, the Earth is spinning.
ccc90ecd0b23cb6e4f9e.id: Matahari seolah-olah bergerak melintasi langit. Sebenarnya, Bumilah yang berputar.

7036b3d366f0ac9d5a8d.en: Shadows are long in the morning and evening. They are short at midday.
7036b3d366f0ac9d5a8d.id: Bayangan panjang pada pagi dan sore hari. Bayangan pendek pada tengah hari.

12ec3c6cf162187ee315.en: Some animals are nocturnal. Owls and bats are active at night.
12ec3c6cf162187ee315.id: Ada hewan yang termasuk nokturnal (nocturnal). Burung hantu dan kelelawar aktif pada malam hari.

dbdec7a14d2d302d75fc.en: The Earth spins. Our side faces the Sun for day and turns away for night.
dbdec7a14d2d302d75fc.id: Bumi berputar. Sisi tempat kita berada menghadap Matahari saat siang dan membelakanginya saat malam.

dd5eeb92b81adc7d42f8.en: The Sun only seems to move. The Earth spins.
dd5eeb92b81adc7d42f8.id: Matahari hanya tampak bergerak. Bumilah yang berputar.

1cd70031b707c81be19f.en: Night comes even when there are no clouds.
1cd70031b707c81be19f.id: Malam tetap datang walaupun tidak ada awan.

e1cdd06845efca5aad0e.en: The Earth takes about 24 hours to spin round once. That is one day and one night.
e1cdd06845efca5aad0e.id: Bumi memerlukan sekitar 24 jam untuk berputar satu kali. Itu sama dengan satu siang dan satu malam.

f080a5585894da402d82.en: At night our side of the Earth faces away from the Sun. The sky is dark, so we can see the stars.
f080a5585894da402d82.id: Saat malam, sisi Bumi tempat kita berada membelakangi Matahari. Langit gelap, jadi kita bisa melihat bintang.

3d76de8374e71be0dafa.en: At midday the Sun is high and the sky is bright.
3d76de8374e71be0dafa.id: Saat tengah hari (midday), Matahari berada tinggi dan langit terang.

942bc01077887221dbaf.en: At lunchtime it is daytime and the sky is bright.
942bc01077887221dbaf.id: Saat makan siang (lunchtime), hari masih siang dan langit terang.

5f37d9b11b48bfb8dbba.id: Setelah sarapan (after breakfast), hari sudah terang.

930e229d5077bcaa8677.en: In the day the Sun is in the bright blue sky and children go to school. At night the stars come out, owls hunt and most people sleep.
930e229d5077bcaa8677.id: Saat siang, Matahari ada di langit biru yang terang dan anak-anak pergi ke sekolah. Saat malam, bintang-bintang muncul, burung hantu berburu, dan kebanyakan orang tidur.

bf09db4ffe3140f9167e.en: The Earth spins round. When our side faces the Sun, we have day. When it turns away from the Sun, we have night.
bf09db4ffe3140f9167e.id: Bumi berputar. Saat sisi tempat kita berada menghadap Matahari, kita mengalami siang. Saat sisi itu membelakangi Matahari, kita mengalami malam.

df2367cdf7568d609962.en: Many people once thought this. The Earth spins, and the Sun only seems to move.
df2367cdf7568d609962.id: Dulu banyak orang berpikir begitu. Bumi berputar, dan Matahari hanya tampak bergerak.

705bbd45e2eb7f2bfc33.en: The Sun always shines. Our side of the Earth turns away from it.
705bbd45e2eb7f2bfc33.id: Matahari selalu bersinar. Sisi Bumi tempat kita berada berputar membelakanginya.

bc76488ca27b5b2cf845.en: The Earth spins round once in about 24 hours. That gives us one day and one night.
bc76488ca27b5b2cf845.id: Bumi berputar satu kali dalam sekitar 24 jam. Itulah yang memberi kita satu siang dan satu malam.

a6ca8675333ccfc9ae62.en: The Sun seems to rise in the east, cross the sky and set in the west. It only seems to move because the Earth is spinning.
a6ca8675333ccfc9ae62.id: Matahari tampak terbit di timur, melintasi langit, dan terbenam di barat. Matahari hanya tampak bergerak karena Bumi sedang berputar.

ae5f71c484cb0470dcde.en: The Sun rises in the east.

cb8e7d7aaa8cc120ba63.en: The Sun seems to move across the sky during the day.
cb8e7d7aaa8cc120ba63.id: Matahari tampak bergerak melintasi langit sepanjang siang.

4a582972294f63e67a11.en: The day goes sunrise, morning, midday, afternoon and sunset. Then it is night.
4a582972294f63e67a11.id: Urutan harinya adalah Matahari terbit (sunrise), pagi (morning), tengah hari (midday), sore (afternoon), dan Matahari terbenam (sunset). Setelah itu, hari menjadi malam.

41890aa951169a63a154.en: At midday the Sun is high, so shadows are short. In the morning and evening the Sun is low, so shadows are long.
41890aa951169a63a154.id: Saat tengah hari, Matahari berada tinggi, jadi bayangan pendek. Saat pagi dan sore, Matahari berada rendah, jadi bayangan panjang.

b397b0114899ee2df3c7.en: Long shadows happen when the Sun is low, in the morning and evening.
b397b0114899ee2df3c7.id: Bayangan panjang muncul saat Matahari rendah, yaitu pada pagi dan sore hari.

a6140a8084d480a76c16.en: At sunset the Sun is low, so shadows are long.
a6140a8084d480a76c16.id: Saat terbenam (sunset), Matahari berada rendah, jadi bayangan panjang.

e3fb69cf93a04022bb82.en: Evening shadows are long because the Sun is low.
e3fb69cf93a04022bb82.id: Bayangan pada sore hari panjang karena Matahari rendah.

18bee13e7c35ace6996a.en: Butterflies, bees and hens are busy in the day. Owls, bats and fireflies are active at night. Night animals are called nocturnal.
18bee13e7c35ace6996a.id: Kupu-kupu, lebah, dan ayam betina sibuk saat siang. Burung hantu, kelelawar, dan kunang-kunang aktif saat malam. Hewan malam disebut nokturnal (nocturnal).

7b08c84a7d6e6118ef93.en: An animal that is active at night is nocturnal. Owls, bats and fireflies are nocturnal.
7b08c84a7d6e6118ef93.id: Hewan yang aktif saat malam disebut nokturnal (nocturnal). Burung hantu, kelelawar, dan kunang-kunang termasuk hewan nokturnal.

3557d78791b6cf59de63.en: Only the half of the Earth that faces the Sun has day. The other side faces away, so it is night there.
3557d78791b6cf59de63.id: Hanya separuh Bumi yang menghadap Matahari yang mengalami siang. Sisi lainnya membelakangi Matahari, jadi di sana malam.

9352345ba99a1cccd3ee.en: The other side is turned away from the Sun.
9352345ba99a1cccd3ee.id: Sisi Bumi yang lain membelakangi Matahari.

fe1023d108f2e60ab94f.en: Day and night do not decide the seasons.
fe1023d108f2e60ab94f.id: Siang dan malam tidak menentukan musim.

dc7e3e7fce9d8bfa33c0.en: The other side faces away from the Sun.

0d9e47eed9a8529b331d.en: The Earth takes about one year, or 365 days, to travel around the Sun. It spins round once every day on the way.
0d9e47eed9a8529b331d.id: Bumi memerlukan sekitar satu tahun, atau 365 hari, untuk mengelilingi Matahari. Di sepanjang perjalanan itu, Bumi berputar satu kali setiap hari.

ccc0b7e6a10c1316b9e0.en: One day is one spin of the Earth.
ccc0b7e6a10c1316b9e0.id: Satu hari adalah satu kali putaran Bumi.

d0129c2701f4667747de.en: One hour is much too short. The trip is very long.
d0129c2701f4667747de.id: Satu jam terlalu singkat. Perjalanannya sangat lama.

88efe8b99750b98bbbfb.en: One week is 7 spins of the Earth.
88efe8b99750b98bbbfb.id: Satu minggu adalah 7 kali putaran Bumi.

51ae6a7cb4984513d00a.en: Stars shine all the time. In the day, the Sun's light is so bright that we cannot see the faint stars.
51ae6a7cb4984513d00a.id: Bintang bersinar sepanjang waktu. Saat siang, cahaya Matahari sangat terang sehingga kita tidak bisa melihat bintang yang redup.

8e822837415b60e4b30b.en: The stars are still there. The sunlight hides them.
8e822837415b60e4b30b.id: Bintang-bintang masih ada di sana. Cahaya matahari menyembunyikan bintang-bintang itu.

9ab0cf81292f4f12ccdb.en: Even on a clear day we cannot see stars.
9ab0cf81292f4f12ccdb.id: Saat siang yang cerah pun, kita tidak bisa melihat bintang.

fea3dbad0503658b87ca.en: From 6 in the morning to 12 is 6 hours, and from 12 to 6 in the evening is 6 more. 6 and 6 make 12 hours of daylight.
fea3dbad0503658b87ca.id: Dari pukul 6 pagi sampai pukul 12 ada 6 jam, dan dari pukul 12 sampai pukul 6 sore ada 6 jam lagi. 6 dan 6 menjadi 12 jam waktu siang.

b6d18ab45f10cb6f389b.en: The Sun rises in the east. Seeing it low in the east means it has just risen, so it is morning.
b6d18ab45f10cb6f389b.id: Matahari terbit di timur. Kalau Matahari terlihat rendah di timur, berarti Matahari baru saja terbit, jadi sekarang pagi.

82a322a9a499242b566f.en: At midday the Sun is high in the sky.
82a322a9a499242b566f.id: Saat tengah hari, Matahari berada tinggi di langit.

8f1fb8257ffa2c354351.en: In the evening the Sun is low in the west.
8f1fb8257ffa2c354351.id: Pada sore hari, Matahari berada rendah di barat.

a5fc6910fc0a8f4270ad.en: At midnight the Sun cannot be seen.
a5fc6910fc0a8f4270ad.id: Pada tengah malam, Matahari tidak terlihat.

489c5977871c62c3d121.en: The Earth spins once a day. As it spins, the Sun seems to move across our sky, just like trees seem to move past a moving car.
489c5977871c62c3d121.id: Bumi berputar satu kali dalam sehari. Saat Bumi berputar, Matahari tampak bergerak melintasi langit kita, sama seperti pohon yang tampak bergerak melewati mobil yang sedang berjalan.

b68f5fc0b3c3b36d7d1e.en: It looks that way, but the Earth is spinning.
b68f5fc0b3c3b36d7d1e.id: Memang terlihat begitu, tetapi Bumilah yang berputar.

ac65fe23cb07bbcac6e1.en: The Sun is far away in space. Our side of the Earth turns away from it.
ac65fe23cb07bbcac6e1.id: Matahari sangat jauh di luar angkasa. Sisi Bumi tempat kita berada berputar membelakanginya.

958f4f7d9d7ba9e50e70.en: At night our side of the Earth faces away from the Sun.
958f4f7d9d7ba9e50e70.id: Pada malam hari, sisi Bumi tempat kita berada membelakangi Matahari.

42e5c1adb9cd4b6e8b44.en: The half of the Earth that faces the Sun has day. The half that faces away has night. As the Earth spins, places move from day to night.
42e5c1adb9cd4b6e8b44.id: Separuh Bumi yang menghadap Matahari mengalami siang. Separuh yang membelakangi Matahari mengalami malam. Saat Bumi berputar, tempat-tempat berpindah dari siang ke malam.

a89e83d5bf1532333b9c.en: The Sun gives us light and heat. At night we cannot see it because our side of the Earth faces away.
a89e83d5bf1532333b9c.id: Matahari (Sun) memberi kita cahaya dan panas. Saat malam, kita tidak bisa melihatnya karena sisi Bumi tempat kita berada membelakanginya.

a36b8b20cb80b9afcf37.en: We see the Moon and the stars at night. The Sun is out in the day.
a36b8b20cb80b9afcf37.id: Kita melihat Bulan dan bintang saat malam. Matahari muncul saat siang.

2399b83c0319ef1232a9.en: We see the Sun in the day and the Moon at night.
2399b83c0319ef1232a9.id: Kita melihat Matahari (Sun) pada siang hari dan Bulan (Moon) pada malam hari.

7ce6bc850dad0c8fa539.en: Sunrise is when the Sun first appears in the morning sky.
7ce6bc850dad0c8fa539.id: Sunrise adalah saat Matahari pertama kali muncul di langit pagi.

7fc12285098c7ef65725.en: Sunset is when the Sun goes down.

2f7d794270262ca65848.en: Midnight is in the middle of the night.

a4fe9ac56b8fe80d6f55.en: Moonrise is when the Moon comes up.

44c62cf6a94b7b2af75c.en: Sunset is when the Sun goes down in the evening.
44c62cf6a94b7b2af75c.id: Sunset adalah saat Matahari turun pada sore hari.

5ec88d6b6c249dfe673d.en: Sunrise is when the Sun comes up.

d79bd90ce91dff317f3c.en: Midday is when the Sun is high.
d79bd90ce91dff317f3c.id: Midday adalah saat Matahari berada tinggi.

b113d7beff79d89daf12.en: Dawn is the start of the day.

a25f782319eb33e49a63.en: The Sun seems to rise in the east and set in the west.
a25f782319eb33e49a63.id: Matahari tampak terbit di timur dan terbenam di barat.

d3afa3b59e13f3dead19.en: The Sun seems to set in the west.

1eb54bc5f12f0d13a157.en: The Sun does not rise in the north.

14b9cf5ea723b85afd9e.en: The Sun does not rise in the south.

114db5e14bc8a082c82e.en: A street lamp makes light, so it helps us see in the dark.
114db5e14bc8a082c82e.id: Lampu jalan menghasilkan cahaya, jadi lampu itu membantu kita melihat saat gelap.

720ea33eb7c7d25a430d.en: The sky is dark at night.

28be30781a19a8ddf33b.en: A shadow is not a light.

5416f51e98b3817f59f5.en: As the Earth spins, the Sun seems to move across the sky. This makes shadows move.
5416f51e98b3817f59f5.id: Saat Bumi berputar, Matahari tampak bergerak melintasi langit. Inilah yang membuat bayangan bergerak.

deeddb60f4e4d833f608.en: The Moon is in the sky for part of the day and part of the night. We can often see it when the Sun is up.
deeddb60f4e4d833f608.id: Bulan berada di langit selama sebagian siang dan sebagian malam. Kita sering bisa melihatnya saat Matahari masih di langit.

89f5f609ea450279c554.en: It is sometimes out in the day.
89f5f609ea450279c554.id: Bulan kadang terlihat pada siang hari.

5a34605d8f9e4c6ef2e3.en: It can happen at any time of year.
5a34605d8f9e4c6ef2e3.id: Hal itu bisa terjadi kapan saja sepanjang tahun.

c2f8c32e24152e06192a.en: Most owls hunt at night and sleep in the day. They are nocturnal.
c2f8c32e24152e06192a.id: Kebanyakan burung hantu berburu saat malam dan tidur saat siang. Burung hantu termasuk hewan nokturnal (nocturnal).

7ac1db32d67002eceef5.en: A hen is awake in the day.
7ac1db32d67002eceef5.id: Ayam betina aktif pada siang hari.

2ea0d86a4bd149db8a5c.en: A squirrel is awake in the day.

7a00d5bb7f59c2da9a11.en: A butterfly flies in the day.

f74a48b726b5d3550e07.en: We can see the Moon, stars and aeroplane lights at night. Rainbows and the Sun are seen in the day.
f74a48b726b5d3550e07.id: Kita bisa melihat Bulan, bintang, dan lampu pesawat saat malam. Pelangi dan Matahari terlihat saat siang.

5e087d52e5e643a349c5.en: The Sun rises in the morning, is highest at midday and sets in the evening. Then it is midnight.
5e087d52e5e643a349c5.id: Matahari terbit pada pagi hari, berada paling tinggi pada tengah hari, dan terbenam pada sore hari. Setelah itu, tibalah tengah malam.

2d9c007803948522e790.en: At sunrise the Sun comes up and at midday it is highest. At sunset it goes down. At midnight it is on the other side of the Earth.
2d9c007803948522e790.id: Saat sunrise, Matahari naik, dan saat midday, Matahari berada paling tinggi. Saat sunset, Matahari turun. Saat midnight, Matahari berada di sisi lain Bumi.

30f8ef10d19c2c52a871.en: The Earth spins once every 24 hours. This gives us day and night.
30f8ef10d19c2c52a871.id: Bumi berputar (spins) satu kali setiap 24 jam. Inilah yang memberi kita siang dan malam (night).

123dd572d19fcb3aa666.en: The Sun is low at sunrise and sunset and high at midday. At midnight it is on the other side of the Earth.
123dd572d19fcb3aa666.id: Matahari berada rendah saat sunrise dan sunset, dan tinggi saat midday. Saat midnight, Matahari berada di sisi lain Bumi.

5c3f14723aeafbe19597.en: At noon the Sun is high, so the shadow is short. The Sun seems to move, so the shadow changes.
5c3f14723aeafbe19597.id: Saat tengah hari, Matahari berada tinggi, jadi bayangannya pendek. Matahari tampak bergerak, jadi bayangannya berubah.

e15d6a1d781cd10bee37.en: A day has 24 hours. Half of 24 is 12 hours.
e15d6a1d781cd10bee37.id: Satu hari ada 24 jam. Setengah dari 24 adalah 12 jam.

c59fd6182d8ee7273f9a.en: As the Earth spins, one side faces the Sun and has day. The other side has night.
c59fd6182d8ee7273f9a.id: Saat Bumi berputar, satu sisi menghadap Matahari dan mengalami siang. Sisi lainnya mengalami malam (night).

e5f850116435478e26a8.en: The Sun rises in the east. When Bayu turns around he faces west.
e5f850116435478e26a8.id: Matahari terbit di timur (east). Saat Bayu berbalik, ia menghadap ke barat (west).

3dd6fa3d07a60db23c8c.en: East is where the Sun rises.

4913c277030e9be4a5e9.en: Each day is one spin, so 3 days is 3 spins.
4913c277030e9be4a5e9.id: Setiap hari ada satu putaran, jadi 3 hari berarti 3 putaran.

0c92cae2189a43a429f1.en: One full spin takes about 24 hours, which gives us a day and a night.
0c92cae2189a43a429f1.id: Satu putaran penuh memerlukan sekitar 24 jam, yang memberi kita satu siang dan satu malam.

bd5677f6d534dce3b8bf.en: The Earth spins. The Sun seems to move, but it is the Earth that turns.
bd5677f6d534dce3b8bf.id: Bumi berputar. Matahari tampak bergerak, padahal Bumi yang berputar.

59175d31c87c2287f9c8.en: The half of the Earth facing the Sun has day. The other half has night.
59175d31c87c2287f9c8.id: Separuh Bumi yang menghadap Matahari mengalami siang. Separuh lainnya mengalami malam.

aae86286432a670bfa73.en: The Sun does not go out. Our part of the Earth turns away from it.
aae86286432a670bfa73.id: Matahari tidak padam. Bagian Bumi tempat kita berada berputar membelakanginya.

2295ee9d38dcb27d679c.en: The Earth spins, so each side faces the Sun and then turns away.
2295ee9d38dcb27d679c.id: Bumi berputar, jadi setiap sisi menghadap Matahari lalu membelakanginya.
